requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: The button could issue more than one clone request or remain gated by a native confirmation dialog.

risk_surfaces.reason: The user action must produce one request and block re-entry while pending.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A second interaction while the request is pending could produce a duplicate clone POST.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Only visual disabled styling without a handler guard could still allow a duplicate invocation.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the exact-head handler guard and button disabled state, then correlate with the passing regression suite.
negative_controls.expected: One clone POST per accepted action with re-entry blocked while cloning.
negative_controls.observed: The handler guards on cloning, the button is disabled during cloning, and Validate PR #7080 passed Test.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A successful API response could be consumed without surfacing all created and skipped totals near the clone action.

risk_surfaces.reason: The API success payload crosses into user-visible feedback in the clone card.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A successful request could finish without useful feedback in the clone card.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The implementation could update state elsewhere or omit one category while the request still succeeds.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the exact-head rendering path and regression assertion for all created and skipped category totals.
negative_controls.expected: All three category totals are rendered in the clone card after success.
negative_controls.observed: The cloneResult rendering is local to the clone card and Validate PR #7080 passed Test.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: An API rejection or a response without data could leave the clone card silent or show the error only elsewhere.

risk_surfaces.reason: API failure and malformed success responses must become local user-visible clone errors.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The action could fail silently for an API rejection or for a successful envelope without clone data.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Only handling rejected promises would leave the missing-data response path silent or undefined.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect explicit missing-data rejection and API error extraction in the exact-head handler with the passing error regression test.
negative_controls.expected: Both API rejection and missing data resolve to cloneError displayed in the clone card.
negative_controls.observed: Contract.tsx throws on absent data and maps API errors to cloneError; Validate PR #7080 passed Test.
